**Key Dates & Periods Extracted from Service Agreement 1**

| Category | Detail (verbatim) | Source |
|----------|-------------------|--------|
| **Initial Term** | “shall remain valid for a period of 1 year, unless mutually extended by the Parties in writing or terminated earlier” | [1] Term and Termination (Master Service Agreement) |
| **Specific Term (Clause 8)** | “effective from 01 June 2025 and shall remain valid till March 31 2026 unless mutually extended by the Parties in writing or terminated earlier” | [2] Term and Termination (Master Service Agreement) |
| **Alternative Term (Clause 11)** | “effective date … 1° April 2023 … valid till 31° March 2024 unless terminated earlier” | [3] Term (Master Service Agreement) |
| **Renewal / Extension** | “mutually extended by the Parties in writing” (appears in all three term clauses) | [1][2][3] |
| **Termination Notice (TATA’s sole discretion)** | “by providing the Service Provider with written notice of 30 (thirty) days” | [1][2] |
| **Breach Cure Period** | “not remedied within 10 (ten) days of receipt of notice” | [1][2] |
| **Insolvency Cure Period** | “60‑day cure period” (mentioned in Clause 9 of the first excerpt) | [1] |
| **Confidential Information Return** | “within 2 (two) business days” (first excerpt) **and** “within 7 business days” (second excerpt) | [1][2] |
| **Notice of Communication (Method)** | “deemed to be duly given … when delivered … or 7 (seven) days after being dispatched in the post” | [4] Notices (Master Service Agreement) |
| **Alternative Notice Method** | “deemed given … when delivered (personal delivery), at the time of transmission (facsimile), …” (no explicit days) | [5] Notices (Master Service Agreement) |
| **Survival of Clauses** | “Clauses … shall survive the expiry or termination of this Agreement.” (list of clauses) | [9] Survival of Key Clauses (Master Service Agreement) |
| **Payment Timeline – Monthly Retainer** | “will be paid … invoiced … monthly in arrears and payable within 45 days from the date of the receipt of such invoice” | [6] Service Fee (Master Service Agreement) |
| **Amended Payment Term** | “Section 6 is amended to extend payment terms from net‑30 to net‑45 days.” | [12] Payment Terms (Master Service Agreement Amendment) |
| **Payment Timeline – Quarterly Retainer (conflict)** | “commercial consideration as quarterly retainers … Tata may withhold disputed amounts …” (no explicit payment days) | [8] Fees, Taxes, Invoicing, and Audit Rights (conflict) |
| **Compliance Obligations** | “shall comply with applicable anti‑bribery, sanctions, export‑control, labour, tax, privacy, and competition laws …” (no date) | [10] Compliance Obligations (Master Services Agreement) |

**Summary of Extracted Periods**

- **Term lengths:** 1 year (generic), 01 Jun 2025–31 Mar 2026, 01 Apr 2023–31 Mar 2024.  
- **Renewal/extension:** Only by mutual written agreement (no fixed period).  
- **Termination notice:** 30 days (TATA’s discretion).  
- **Cure periods:** 10 days for breach, 60 days for insolvency.  
- **Post‑termination data return:** 2 business days (first clause) vs. 7 business days (second clause) – conflict noted.  
- **Notice of communication:** 7 days after posting (one clause) vs. no fixed days in the alternative clause.  
- **Survival:** Specified clauses survive termination indefinitely (no time limit).  
- **Payment:** Invoices payable within 45 days (monthly retainer) and net‑45 days per amendment; quarterly‑retainer schedule lacks a specific payment day (conflict).  
- **Compliance deadlines:** No explicit dates; obligations are continuous.  

**Conflicts Highlighted**

- Confidential‑information return period (2 business days vs. 7 business days).  
- Payment schedule (monthly + 45‑day payment vs. quarterly retainers with no explicit payment period).  
- Notice effectiveness (7 days after post vs. no explicit period in the alternative clause).  

---  

**References**

[1] Term and Termination (Master Service Agreement), Clause 9 & Clause 8, Quote: “shall remain valid for a period of 1 year…”, “effective from 01 June 2025…”, “Termination by TATA … 30 (thirty) days; … not remedied within 10 (ten) days…”, “upon termination … within 2 (two) business days”.  

[2] Term and Termination (Master Service Agreement), Clause 8, Quote: “upon termination … the Service Provider s…”, (truncated but indicates 7 business days).  

[3] Term (Master Service Agreement), Quote: “effective … 1° April 2023 … valid till 31° March 2024”.  

[4] Notices (Master Service Agreement), Clause 16.3, Quote: “deemed to be duly given … or 7 (seven) days after being dispatched in the post”.  

[5] Notices (Master Service Agreement), Clause 14.3, Quote: “deemed given … when delivered (personal delivery), at the time of transmission (facsimile)”.  

[6] Service Fee (Master Service Agreement), Clause 3.1 & Schedule II, Quote: “Retainer fee will be invoiced … monthly in arrears and will be paid within 45 days”.  

[8] Fees, Taxes, Invoicing, and Audit Rights (Master Service Agreement), Clause 4, Quote: “Commercial consideration … quarterly retainers …”.  

[9] Survival of Key Clauses (Master Service Agreement), Clause 14.11, Quote: “Clauses … shall survive the expiry or termination of this Agreement”.  

[10] Compliance Obligations (Master Services Agreement), Quote: “The Service Provider shall comply with applicable anti‑bribery, sanctions, export‑control, labour, tax, privacy, and competition laws…”.  

[12] Payment Terms (Master Service Agreement Amendment), Section 6, Quote: “Section 6 is amended to extend payment terms from net‑30 to net‑45 days”.
